The '''IM series''' was a model of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] manufactured by [[Droid Security Systems]], a division of [[Sacul Industries Group]], and was present on their logo. Similar in appearance to the [[DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid/Legends|DRK-1 Dark Eye probe droid]], they possessed a multitude of sensors and had [[Color/Legends|blue]] and silver plating.<ref name="The Adventures Continue" /> By about the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> the IM series had undergone improvements and were used in [[Spaceport THX1138]].<ref name="The Adventures Continue" />

==Behind the scenes==
The IM series was created for [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', which opened on [[May 7]], [[2013]].<ref name="The Adventures Continue" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' {{1st}} {{C|Tokyo only}}
